title: Sippin on Sunshine Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sippin on Sunshine is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 12)- 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- 6 Passenger Electric Cart Included in Rental- Parking for 2 Vehicles- 4 King Bedrooms- Two Refrigerators in Main House- Dedicated Office Space- Carriage House- Two Outdoor Fireplaces- Propane Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- 3 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Camp Watercolor- 5 Minute Bike Ride to Watercolor Beach Club Access- 8 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside Welcome to "Sippin on Sunshine" at 260 Needlerush Drive, an enchanting vacation retreat nestled in the picturesque Lake District of WaterColor. This immaculately maintained 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath luxury home, aptly named for its tranquil and luminous ambiance, marries comfort with sophistication and a suite of amenities for a genuinely opulent stay. Upon entering, you are greeted by a vibrant, coastal-inspired living room, where bright, lively colors vividly reflect the seaside surroundings. The gourmet kitchen, swathed in soothing sea blue tones, features premium stainless-steel appliances, and opens into a spacious dining area that seats eight at the main table, plus an additional three at the stylish kitchen bar. Just off the kitchen, a luxurious wet bar enhances the home's entertainment options, perfect for concocting your favorite drinks. Nearby, the laundry room is equipped with a secondary refrigerator and a full-size washer and dryer, adding a layer of convenience to your extended stay. This level also includes a half bathroom and a dedicated office space, ensuring that productivity and connectivity are never compromised during your getaway. The first floor is further adorned with two sumptuous king bedrooms, each boasting its own modern ensuite bathroom with sleek walk-in showers, providing the ultimate in privacy and relaxation. The second floor introduces a refined king bedroom linked by a jack and jill bathroom with a convenient shower/tub combination to a delightful bunk room, ideal for children or young adults, featuring a full-over-full and a twin-over-twin bunk bed. This thoughtful layout offers flexible sleeping arrangements for multiple guests. The carriage house stands as a secluded sanctuary, complete with a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy living area, and a serene king bedroom with an ensuite that includes a contemporary walk-in shower. It also features a private balcony, the perfect spot for unwinding and enjoying the outdoors in solitude. Outdoor living is a prominent feature of this property. The front porch, outfitted with a four Adirondack chairs and oversized swing, provides a picturesque setting for morning coffee while observing the peaceful bike traffic. The screened side porch, complete a gas fireplace and a flat-screen TV, creates the ultimate entertainment enclave. Additionally, the property includes a freestanding outdoor fireplace flanked by Adirondack chairs and a high-quality propane grill, ideal for enchanting evenings under the stars. Six adult bikes are provided, allowing for a brisk 5-minute ride to the WaterColor Beach Club. Explore Seaside and the surrounding areas with ease using the included 6-passenger electric cart. Book your stay at "Sippin on Sunshine" through Sanders Beach Rentals and discover the idyllic setting for an unforgettable vacation on 30A.
